description: Return Dimensions DSL schema metadata loaded at server startup. Default: compact summary with source/entity counts and resource URIs. Use full=true or dimensions://schema for the complete describe payload. Optionally fetch live describe for a single source or entity.

full.description: When true, return the full raw describe schema instead of the summary

live.description: When true, fetch fresh describe for source/entity from the API

name: describe_schema

schema.description: Full or sliced schema when full=true or source/entity is set

title: Describe schema
